id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|176c: "For those I must protect... I can't lose! Begone, fiends!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1920: "What is it, Lady Eleonor? ...There's no one here?
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1978: "Oh... must be my imagination. I felt the presence of that child... {var:1}...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a08: "He should be in the council room with Irwin now...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a84: "Today is an important day for {var:1}, so I mustn't be anxious. I must stay strong at a time like this.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b8c: "Today is an important day for {var:1}, so I mustn't be anxious. I must stay strong at a time like this.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ca8: "I feel like I have a little brother! When {var:1} grows up, I'll play with him lots!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dc4: "Huff, huff... Did Irwin head to the throne room? I hope he's safe...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e8c: "Our Dundrasil will be fine. Even if the castle dies, as long as the people live we can rebuild again and again...!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fac: "Our Dundrasil will be fine. Even if the castle dies, as long as the people live we can rebuild again and again...!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2130: "I won't hand {var:1}, the child of hope, to evil fiends! We'll scatter them!!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2240: "Ngh... no matter how many we kill, more monsters keep coming. Can we hold against this many...!?
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23dc: "Ha ha, what fun! Great food and guests all royalty from every land! As expected of the Luminary's unveiling party!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24c8: "For my son soon to be born, I'll hold a feast as grand as this party!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25cc: "W-who was it that said we'd be fine with the Luminary here!? We're not fine at all!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|275c: "The Four Great Nations Summit, with kings from every land gathered... This may stir up trouble.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|281c: "Now then... let's see what you can do. Ha ha ha...!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28f8: "How terrible! To capture the legendary Luminary, will the monsters destroy the whole country!?
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29c4: "O Yggdrasil! Protect us with your sacred breath...!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b30: "Hmm, like my Gallopolis, I sense the knightly spirit in Dundrasil's soldiers too.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2bf0: "Probably they faithfully follow the teachings of Lord Irwin, king and knight commander, and train daily.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cfc: "What will be decided at the Four Great Nations Summit... I feel uneasy somehow.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2dc8: "Sultan, don't worry! I can't lose you here! I'll protect you with my life!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f68:
The soldier doesn't move a muscle.
He doesn't seem to see {var:1}.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|304c:
He looks a bit tense, perhaps as the
Four Great Nations Summit is about to start.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3158:
He glares at the door in silence,
desperately protecting the King of Sniflheim.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32a0: "Lord Irwin speaks as an equal even to an ordinary soldier like me...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|333c: "I'm truly lucky to serve under a wonderful king like Lord Irwin.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|34fc: "Is that the Luminary's Star that's been giving off an odd light lately... It's an eerie light.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|35bc: "The Luminary was born and it's a celebration, yet... I hope it's not an ill omen.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36a8: "The Four Great Nations Summit is about to begin, so we're ordered to tighten security. You too, do your best.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|37ac: No reply. He seems to have already died.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a238: No reply. He seems to have already died.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a5e0: No reply. He seems to have already died.

id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|38c4: "Honestly, you! How many times must I tell you!?
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e78: "Honestly, you! How many times must I tell you!?
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3920: "Lady Eleonor's room is through that door, then left! Lord Irwin will be here soon!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39e8: "Lady Eleonor's room is through the door there, then left! Lord Irwin will be here soon!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f90: "Lady Eleonor's room is through the door there, then left! Lord Irwin will be here soon!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b44: "You say that, but you dozed off while on guard the other day...! You're all talk!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c40: "Damn monster! In the name of Dundrasil, I'll surely slay you!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d1c: "Fear us, fiend! This is the power of Dundrasil!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ed4: "Lady Eleonor's room is through this door, then left! Lord Irwin will be here soon!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|40ec: "It's fine, senior! I'm second to none at guard duty! Leave it to me! Leave it to me!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|41f4: "I'm usually scolded, but my sword skill is top in the knight corps!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|42e0: "H-huh...? I haven't finished it yet... Heh, lucky!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4428: "Lord Irwin was originally Lady Eleonor's guard, Dundrasil's strongest knight.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|44b8: "Saving Lady Eleonor from a monster attack began their romance. I too someday wish for such a meeting...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|457c: "W-what am I saying! Do I train with such impure motives!? I must toughen my spirit!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|468c: "I'll show you the power of Dundrasil!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4708: "Fear us! Dundrasil won't fall so easily!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4834: "Lately requests to subdue monsters keep coming from around the world. I hope nothing bad happens...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|495c: "I can't lose... I'll never hand over the Luminary!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4b1c: "Ah, I'd like to see the Luminary even once. Maybe I'll slip out of work to look...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4cfc: "Ah, I'd like to see the Luminary even once. Maybe I'll slip out of work to look...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4bbc: "...No! No, no! Royalty from around the world is here today. I must guard the castle with extra spirit!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d9c: "...No! No, no! Royalty from around the world is here today. I must guard the castle with extra spirit!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4ecc: "Don't think an attack this weak can take Dundrasil!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4f78: "I-I did it! It's the fruit of daily training! Fear us, ha ha!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5064: "Ngh, monsters from this side too...! I must protect this main gate at all costs!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|512c: "Somehow I beat it. But no more than this...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5244: "{var:1}'s hand has the same mark as the Luminary... How I admire that...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5308: "{var:1}'s hand has the same mark as the Luminary... How I admire that...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5458: "When did you beat it...!? G-god, thank you!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|551c: "No! A horde of monsters is already pressing up to the gate! Escaping by the main gate is impossible...!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|573c: "Damn! Monsters have finally reached even here...!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|57d4: "We did it! We somehow defended the back gate...!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|589c: "Ugh... Lord Irwin and the others went through that door...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|58fc: "Ugh... Lord Irwin and the others headed to the storeroom...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5954: "If they get through the underground passage there, the Luminary should get out safely... Thank goodness, truly...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5ab4: "The one running so energetically a moment ago was Heliodor's princess... Like her late mother the Queen, a beauty.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5bc4: "It's finally starting... Today will be an important day carved into history.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5cac: "Everyone, hang in there! Until Yggdrasil guides us, we must hold out here somehow!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5e00: "Laughter from the King and Queen's room again. Ah, so soothing...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5f10: "The Four Great Nations Summit finally begins... You surely haven't forgotten where the council room is, have you?
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6490: "The Four Great Nations Summit finally begins... You surely haven't forgotten where the council room is, have you?
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5fe0: "Don't make fun of me! The council room is straight ahead after leaving the throne room. How could I forget!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6560: "Don't make fun of me! The council room is straight ahead after leaving the throne room. How could I forget!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6090: "Ha ha ha, just in case. If anything happens to the kings, rush there immediately!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6610: "Ha ha ha, just in case. If anything happens to the kings, rush there immediately!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6184: "Monsters even in the sacred throne room...! Damn! I must beat them!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6260: "Huff, huff... Did it just die by itself...? Oh well...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6384: "Since {var:1} was born, the Queen has looked so happy. She has fully taken on a mother's face...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6704: "Ngh, you're good...! But we won't let you do as you please!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|67ac: "Good, I got it somehow. But there are too many...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|68dc: "Born as the legendary Luminary... What sort of life will {var:1} lead?
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6aa0: "Born as the legendary Luminary... What sort of life will {var:1} lead?
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6980: "Well, whatever fate awaits, as the child of Dundrasil's King and Queen he'll be loved by all.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b44: "Well, whatever fate awaits, as the child of Dundrasil's King and Queen he'll be loved by all.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6c48: "I-if not for the soldier, I'd have been killed by monsters... Thank you, truly thank you...!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6db4: "Oh dear... she's gone missing again. Well, a royal banquet is boring for a child that age.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6f4c: "Oh dear... she's gone missing again. Well, a royal banquet is boring for a child that age.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6e54: "Princess Jade of Heliodor is already famed as a tomboy, so where could she have gone...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6fec: "Princess Jade of Heliodor is already famed as a tomboy, so where could she have gone...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|70d4: "Eek! Go! There! Ah, how frustrating! Come on, hurry up and beat it!!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7190: "I'm glad that soldier beat the monster. My strong cheering must have reached him.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|72c0: "Lord Irwin and the others took the Luminary to the first floor...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7488: "As the banquet for Dundrasil's prince's debut, the guests are all of distinguished royal lineage. I must not be rude.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|75a4: "I don't want to be here one more second. Someone, please come save us quickly...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|773c: "Huh? Must be my imagination... I thought someone called me.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|77e8: "I never expected monsters to come... Can we hold out here...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7954: "Eek! Eek! Monsters! Monsters! Soldier, help quickly!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7a20: "Targeting a helpless woman like me, monsters are the worst!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7b30: "D-don't underestimate me! There's no way I'd lose to the likes of you!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7b94: "...Still, that guy who hit on me ran off alone! If I make it out alive, I'll punch him...!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7ca0: "I-I'm saved...! That guy who hit on me ran off alone! That's why men can't be trusted!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7e28: "Oh, how awful! Lord Rab hid new naughty books under his bed again!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7eb4: "Lady Eleonor found them all and confiscated them the other day. Honestly... mutter, mutter.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7f7c: "Hey, Minister! Hide somewhere else! I'll get found too!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8060: "Hey, Minister! Hide somewhere else! I'll get found too!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8144: "Hey, Minister! Hide somewhere else! I'll get found too!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8298: "Lord Rab was so engrossed in Erdwin's Chronicle, handed down in Dundrasil since ancient times. It says...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8370: "No, no, I mustn't! On the happy day celebrating {var:1}'s birth, I won't think unnecessary things!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8458: "W-w-what a thing! Dundrasil attacked by monsters! Ah, Lord Irwin...!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|85ac: "Hee hee, no need to rush. Once the Four Great Nations Summit ends, {var:1} will be unveiled right away.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8648: "Come to think of it, Lord Irwin just went to the courtyard where the King of Heliodor is. The summit may start soon.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|874c: "Get a grip! It's not just you! Everyone wants to go home but is enduring this...!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|88a4: "Isn't {var:1}'s unveiling yet? As the son of Dundrasil's King and Queen, he must have a splendid face.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8960: "He's just a baby now, but someday he'll bear Dundrasil on his shoulders. Ah! I want to meet him soon.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8a50: "It was so much fun until a moment ago. Why did this happen... Send me home, let me go home...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8ba0: "With the Luminary born, Erdrea's peace is as good as promised. This too must be Yggdrasil's guidance.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8cdc: "Hiding here, the monsters will find us soon. But outside, monsters have us surrounded...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8d9c: "Will we die either way? I don't want to, I don't want to die...!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8ea4: "I'm related to famous royalty. If you like, I'll introduce you to them sometime.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8f94: "I'm related to famous royalty. If you like, I'll introduce you to them sometime.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9084: "I can't, I can't. There's no way to beat monsters like that. I don't want to die, Mama...!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|91d0: "Lord Irwin, Lord Rab, and the King of Heliodor went up the stairs...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9258: "At last the Four Great Nations will talk in the third-floor council room. What will happen...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9364: "The one I saw earlier was Lady Eleonor, Queen of Dundrasil, wasn't it... So beautiful and pure...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9424: "Looked at by those gentle eyes, anyone's heart would be cleansed.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9510: "The monsters are after the Luminary! So why must we suffer this!?
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|95b8: "We'll die because of the Luminary! Sob, sob...!!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9700: "I was asked to emcee {var:1}'s unveiling, but now I'm getting nervous...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|97a4: "Right, at a time like this, return to basics and recall what I do every day at church. Ahem...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9900: "...I feel it! I feel it! Faintly, but... the presence of one who brings hope to this country!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9a08:
{var:1}'s HP and MP
were fully restored!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9a3c: "O one who brings hope to Dundrasil... I too want to lend you my strength. What can a priest like me do...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9bb0: "Dundrasil is a country of history. Since ancient times it has offered deep faith to Yggdrasil, the world's center.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9cac: "That faith bore fruit, and Yggdrasil must have entrusted the Luminary to Dundrasil.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9da4: "Damn... move, legs! If I stop here, I'll just be killed... Move!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9f04: "Hendrik, Heliodor's young general rapidly rising to prominence...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9f90: "I passed him in the town earlier, and that presence is a true hero's... Men like that will move the world.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a164: "Ow... the monster's wound hurts. I must heal fast and get back to training...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a32c: "The Luminary's birth is certainly a happy thing, but...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a498: "The Luminary's birth is certainly a happy thing, but...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a3a0: "Why do the King and the others look so glum? Are they hiding something from us...?
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a50c: "Why do the King and the others look so glum? Are they hiding something from us...?
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a6d4: "...But why hold the Four Great Nations Summit on the very day of {var:1}'s unveiling?
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a880: "...But why hold the Four Great Nations Summit on the very day of {var:1}'s unveiling?
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a77c: "Is there something important they must decide urgently...? Does it involve {var:1}...?
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a928: "Is there something important they must decide urgently...? Does it involve {var:1}...?
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ab18: "To think Lady Eleonor would bear the Luminary... How joyous.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ad88: "To think Lady Eleonor would bear the Luminary... How joyous.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|aba0: "As a child she was such a tomboy that all the castle folk struggled, but she did have a mysterious aura...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ae10: "As a child she was such a tomboy that all the castle folk struggled, but she did have a mysterious aura...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ac7c: "...Oops, if anyone heard this talk, it'd be trouble. Well, back to work.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|aeec: "...Oops, if anyone heard this talk, it'd be trouble. Well, back to work.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b0a0: "This is Dundrasil cuisine, chosen among the world's three great cuisines... So delicious it melts the tongue.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b188: "Ah... how long must we hide here... What's happening outside...?
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b2bc: "Raising a newborn as the Luminary gives me chills just thinking about it. I couldn't bear that pressure.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b3d0: "I'll pretend to be a wall and get through this...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b4d4: "Lord Irwin excels as a knight in valor and has a king's wisdom too, a great man.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b59c: "And on top of that his child is the Luminary, so perfect I'm speechless...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b6a4: He seems to lack even the strength to speak.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b7ac: "What's with everyone and the Luminary... A being who appears only in old legends sounds fishy to me.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b888: "More believable than the Luminary is General Hendrik of Heliodor. His strength truly deserves the name hero.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|baa4: "Lately monsters are increasing around the world and some towns suffer. The world's become dangerous...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bb7c: "But the Luminary has been born, so he'll surely protect us. The world is safe now.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bc80: "Father, Mother... please forgive your daughter for leaving before you...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bde0: "The one chosen by Yggdrasil, huh... Dundrasil's people are devout, so they don't doubt the Luminary, but...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bee0: "Having the same mark as the legendary Luminary doesn't mean {var:1} is the Luminary. It's too early to decide.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c008: "It's fine... because the kings of every land are gathered in this castle for the Four Great Nations Summit.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c0d0: "To rescue the kings, soldiers from many countries should be heading to Dundrasil now...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c248: "The hand of the Luminary who once saved the world bore the mark of the one chosen by Yggdrasil... the Dragon Crest.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c350: "And this is a rumor, but {var:1}'s hand is said to have the same mark as that Luminary.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c418: "If only I hadn't come to the Luminary's unveiling party, this wouldn't have happened...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c504: "Play dead, play dead... If found, I'll really be killed...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c638: "Gwa ha ha ha! Foolish humans who protect the Luminary! This will be your graveyard!

id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c850: "Now, humans! Hand the Luminary to our master, Mordegon!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ca48: "Now hand over the Luminary! Lord Mordegon will put the Luminary's power to better use than you!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cc28: A monster felled by a soldier lies there.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cd30: "Gehyahya! Weak, weak! Before Heliodor's general Hendrik arrives, I'll wipe you all out!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cf60: "Now, insect-like humans. I'll tear out your guts with my claws!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d15c: "I won't ease your pain quickly. I'll torment you slowly. Now writhe and suffer!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d34c: "Lord Mordegon ordered that every human but the Luminary may be killed! I'll burn this whole castle!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d578: "I'll destroy this country without a trace too! Like when we attacked the Kingdom of Champs Sauvages!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d738:
Silent, he stays rooted
like an empty shell...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d818: "{var:1}... sorry. Leave me alone for a while.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d908: "I'm just a lowly rogue. Since I came to these Dundrasil Castle ruins, I've been hunting for treasure...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d9b0: "I moved some rubble here and found a really suspicious stairway going underground!
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|da58: "But from deep in this stairway came a weird voice. 'So regrettable... so regrettable...'
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|db04: "Maybe... a grudge of the Dundrasil people attacked sixteen years ago... Brr, so scary...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dc1c: "Thanks to you, the weird voice from deep in this stairway can't be heard anymore.
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dcb4: "I gave up treasure hunting too. So the Dundrasil people's souls should rest in peace...
id./param/region/r009.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ddbc: No reply. He seems to have lost consciousness.

tm.「守るべき者のために……。\n 負けるわけには いかない！\n 魔の者たちよ 消: "For those I must protect... I can't lose! Begone, fiends!
tm.「どうしたの エレノアさま？\n ……誰も いないわよ？: "What is it, Lady Eleonor? ...There's no one here?
tm.「あら…… 気のせいかしらね。\n あの子の……{var:1}の\n 気配を感じ: "Oh... must be my imagination. I felt the presence of that child... {var:1}...
tm.「今は アーウィンと一緒に\n 会議室に いるはずよね……。: "He should be in the council room with Irwin now...
tm.「今日は {var:1}にとって 大事な日なのに\n 私が 不安がってちゃダメよ: "Today is an important day for {var:1}, so I mustn't be anxious. I must stay strong at a time like this.
tm.「弟ができたみたいで うれしいな！\n {var:1}が 大きくなったら\n い: "I feel like I have a little brother! When {var:1} grows up, I'll play with him lots!
tm.「はあはあ……。\n アーウィンが向かったのは 玉座の間か？\n 無事だといいが: "Huff, huff... Did Irwin head to the throne room? I hope he's safe...
tm.「我がユグノアは 絶対に大丈夫じゃ。\n 城が死んでも 民が生きてさえいれば\n: "Our Dundrasil will be fine. Even if the castle dies, as long as the people live we can rebuild again and again...!
tm.「邪悪な 魔の者などに\n 希望の子 {var:1}は渡さん！\n 我らが けち: "I won't hand {var:1}, the child of hope, to evil fiends! We'll scatter them!!
tm.「くっ……いくら 倒しても\n 次から次へと 魔物が現れる。\n この数 ふせぎ: "Ngh... no matter how many we kill, more monsters keep coming. Can we hold against this many...!?
tm.「いやあ～ ゆかい ゆかい！\n 料理はウマいし 客は 各国の王族ばかり！\n: "Ha ha, what fun! Great food and guests all royalty from every land! As expected of the Luminary's unveiling party!
tm.「もうすぐ生まれる わしの息子にも\n このパーティーに負けないくらいの\n 盛: "For my son soon to be born, I'll hold a feast as grand as this party!
tm.「だ 誰だ 勇者がいれば\n 大丈夫なんて言ったヤツは！？\n 全然 大丈夫じゃ: "W-who was it that said we'd be fine with the Luminary here!? We're not fine at all!
tm.「各国の王が集結する 四大国会議……。\n これは ひと波乱ありそうじゃのう。: "The Four Great Nations Summit, with kings from every land gathered... This may stir up trouble.
tm.「さて……。\n お手並み拝見させてもらおうかの。\n かっかっか……！: "Now then... let's see what you can do. Ha ha ha...!
tm.「なんということだ！\n 伝説の勇者を 捕らえるために\n 魔物どもめ 国ごと滅: "How terrible! To capture the legendary Luminary, will the monsters destroy the whole country!?
tm.「命の大樹よ！\n どうか その 神聖なる息吹で\n 我々をお守りくだされ……！: "O Yggdrasil! Protect us with your sacred breath...!
tm.「ふーむ 我が サマディー王国と同じく\n ユグノア王国の兵士からも\n 騎士道: "Hmm, like my Gallopolis, I sense the knightly spirit in Dundrasil's soldiers too.
tm.「おそらく 王であり 騎士団長でもある\n アーウィンさまの教えを忠実に守り\n: "Probably they faithfully follow the teachings of Lord Irwin, king and knight commander, and train daily.
tm.「四大国会議で\n いったい 何が決まるのか……。\n なんだか 落ち着かないな: "What will be decided at the Four Great Nations Summit... I feel uneasy somehow.
tm.「サマディー王 ご安心ください！\n ここで あなたを失うワケには いかない！\: "Sultan, don't worry! I can't lose you here! I'll protect you with my life!
tm.兵士は 微動だにしない。\nどうやら {var:1}の姿が\n見えていないようだ:
The soldier doesn't move a muscle.
He doesn't seem to see {var:1}.
tm.四大国会議が 始まろうとしているためか\n心なしか 緊張した表情をしている。:
He looks a bit tense, perhaps as the
Four Great Nations Summit is about to start.
tm.無言で 扉をにらみながら\nクレイモラン王を 必死に守っている。:
He glares at the door in silence,
desperately protecting the King of Sniflheim.
tm.「私のような 一般の兵士にも\n アーウィンさまは 対等に\n 話しかけてくださ: "Lord Irwin speaks as an equal even to an ordinary soldier like me...
tm.「アーウィンさまのような\n すばらしい王のもとで はたらけて\n 私は 本当に: "I'm truly lucky to serve under a wonderful king like Lord Irwin.
tm.「あれが 最近 妙な光を放っている\n 勇者の星か……。\n なんだか 不気味な: "Is that the Luminary's Star that's been giving off an odd light lately... It's an eerie light.
tm.「せっかく 勇者さまが誕生して\n お祝いムードだっていうのに……。\n 不吉な: "The Luminary was born and it's a celebration, yet... I hope it's not an ill omen.
tm.「もうすぐ 四大国会議が始まるから\n 警備を さらに厳重にしろとの命令だ。\n: "The Four Great Nations Summit is about to begin, so we're ordered to tighten security. You too, do your best.
tm.返事がない。すでに こときれているようだ。: No reply. He seems to have already died.
tm.「まったく お前は！\n 何度言ったら わかるんだ！？: "Honestly, you! How many times must I tell you!?
tm.「エレノアさまの お部屋は\n 向こうの扉を開けて 左に曲がった先だ！\n もう: "Lady Eleonor's room is through that door, then left! Lord Irwin will be here soon!
tm.「エレノアさまの お部屋は\n そこの扉を開けて 左に曲がった先だ！\n もうす: "Lady Eleonor's room is through the door there, then left! Lord Irwin will be here soon!
tm.「お前 そんなこと言って こないだ\n 警備しながら 居眠りしてたくせに……！\: "You say that, but you dozed off while on guard the other day...! You're all talk!
tm.「おのれ 魔物め！\n ユグノア王国の名にかけて\n 必ずや お前を しとめてみ: "Damn monster! In the name of Dundrasil, I'll surely slay you!
tm.「おそれいったか 魔の者め！\n これが ユグノア王国のチカラだ！: "Fear us, fiend! This is the power of Dundrasil!
tm.「エレノアさまの お部屋は\n この扉を開けて 左に曲がった先だ！\n もうすぐ: "Lady Eleonor's room is through this door, then left! Lord Irwin will be here soon!
tm.「大丈夫です センパイ！\n 自分 警備の仕事なら 誰にも負けません！\n ドー: "It's fine, senior! I'm second to none at guard duty! Leave it to me! Leave it to me!
tm.「ボクはなあ！\n 普段 怒られてばっかりだけどなあ！\n 剣のウデは 騎士団で: "I'm usually scolded, but my sword skill is top in the knight corps!
tm.「あ あれ……？\n まだ トドメさしてないのに……。\n へへ ラッキー！: "H-huh...? I haven't finished it yet... Heh, lucky!
tm.「アーウィンさまは もともと\n エレノアさまを お守りしていた\n ユグノア王: "Lord Irwin was originally Lady Eleonor's guard, Dundrasil's strongest knight.
tm.「魔物に襲われた エレノアさまを\n 救ったのが 恋の始まりだった。\n 私も: "Saving Lady Eleonor from a monster attack began their romance. I too someday wish for such a meeting...
tm.「な 何を言ってるんだ 私は！\n そんな不純な動機で訓練しているのか！？\n: "W-what am I saying! Do I train with such impure motives!? I must toughen my spirit!
tm.「ユグノアのチカラ\n 見せてくれる！: "I'll show you the power of Dundrasil!
tm.「おそれいったか！\n ユグノアは そう 簡単には\n 攻め落とせないぞ！: "Fear us! Dundrasil won't fall so easily!
tm.「最近 世界各地から 我が国へ\n 魔物討伐の依頼が 後を絶たない。\n よから: "Lately requests to subdue monsters keep coming from around the world. I hope nothing bad happens...
tm.「負けるワケには いかない……。\n 勇者さまは 絶対に渡さないぞ！: "I can't lose... I'll never hand over the Luminary!
tm.「ああ オレも 勇者さまを\n ひとめだけでも 見たいなあ。\n 仕事を抜けて: "Ah, I'd like to see the Luminary even once. Maybe I'll slip out of work to look...
tm.「……いや！ ダメだ ダメだ！\n 今日は 世界中の王族が集まってるんだ。\n: "...No! No, no! Royalty from around the world is here today. I must guard the castle with extra spirit!
tm.「これしきの 攻撃で\n この ユグノアが落とせると思うな！: "Don't think an attack this weak can take Dundrasil!
tm.「や やった 倒したぞ！\n これも 日頃の訓練の たまもの！\n おそれいった: "I-I did it! It's the fruit of daily training! Fear us, ha ha!
tm.「くっ こちらからも魔物が……！\n この正門だけは 絶対に守らねば！: "Ngh, monsters from this side too...! I must protect this main gate at all costs!
tm.「なんとか 倒せたようだ。\n しかし もう これ以上は……。: "Somehow I beat it. But no more than this...
tm.「{var:1}さまの手には\n 勇者さまと同じアザが あるのか……。\n そう: "{var:1}'s hand has the same mark as the Luminary... How I admire that...
tm.「いつの間に 倒したんだ……！？\n か 神よ 感謝します！: "When did you beat it...!? G-god, thank you!
tm.「ダメだ！ もうそこまで\n 魔物の大群が 押しよせている！\n 正門から脱出は: "No! A horde of monsters is already pressing up to the gate! Escaping by the main gate is impossible...!
tm.「くそ！ とうとう魔物が\n こんな所にまで……！: "Damn! Monsters have finally reached even here...!
tm.「やった！ 裏門は\n なんとか防衛できたぞ……！: "We did it! We somehow defended the back gate...!
tm.「ううう……アーウィンさまたちが\n そこの扉に入っていかれた……。: "Ugh... Lord Irwin and the others went through that door...
tm.「ううう……アーウィンさまたちが\n 倉庫に 向かわれた……。: "Ugh... Lord Irwin and the others headed to the storeroom...
tm.「あそこの地下通路を抜けられれば\n 勇者さまは 無事に 外に出られるはず……。: "If they get through the underground passage there, the Luminary should get out safely... Thank goodness, truly...
tm.「先ほど 元気よく走られていたのは\n デルカダールの姫君か……。\n 亡くなら: "The one running so energetically a moment ago was Heliodor's princess... Like her late mother the Queen, a beauty.
tm.「いよいよ 始まるのか……。\n 今日という日は 歴史に刻まれる\n 重要な日と: "It's finally starting... Today will be an important day carved into history.
tm.「皆さん がんばってください！\n 命の大樹が 我々を導いてくださるまで\n な: "Everyone, hang in there! Until Yggdrasil guides us, we must hold out here somehow!
tm.「王と王妃の部屋から\n また 笑い声が聞こえるな。\n ああ 癒やされるなあ…: "Laughter from the King and Queen's room again. Ah, so soothing...
tm.「いよいよ 四大国会議が始まるが……。\n お前 まさか 会議室の場所を\n 忘: "The Four Great Nations Summit finally begins... You surely haven't forgotten where the council room is, have you?
tm.「バカにするなよ！ 会議室は\n 玉座の間を出て まっすぐ行った先。\n 忘れる: "Don't make fun of me! The council room is straight ahead after leaving the throne room. How could I forget!
tm.「はっはっは 万が一ということがあるからな。\n 王たちの身に何かあったら\n: "Ha ha ha, just in case. If anything happens to the kings, rush there immediately!
tm.「魔物が 神聖なる玉座の間にまで……！\n くそっ！ 必ず倒さなければ！: "Monsters even in the sacred throne room...! Damn! I must beat them!
tm.「はあはあ……。\n 今 勝手に死んだような……？\n まあ いっか……。: "Huff, huff... Did it just die by itself...? Oh well...
tm.「{var:1}さまが生まれてから\n 王妃さまは とても幸せそうだな。\n す: "Since {var:1} was born, the Queen has looked so happy. She has fully taken on a mother's face...
tm.「くっ なかなかやるな……！\n だが お前たちの好きなようにはさせん！: "Ngh, you're good...! But we won't let you do as you please!
tm.「よし なんとか しとめたな。\n しかし 数が多すぎる……。: "Good, I got it somehow. But there are too many...
tm.「伝説の勇者として生まれて……。\n {var:1}さまは これから\n どうい: "Born as the legendary Luminary... What sort of life will {var:1} lead?
tm.「まあ どんな運命が待っていても\n ユグノア王と 王妃から生まれた子供だし\n: "Well, whatever fate awaits, as the child of Dundrasil's King and Queen he'll be loved by all.
tm.「へ…兵士さんが いなかったら\n 私 魔物に殺されてたわ……。\n ありがとう: "I-if not for the soldier, I'd have been killed by monsters... Thank you, truly thank you...!
tm.「もう……また いなくなっちゃったわ。\n まあ あのくらいのトシの子には\n: "Oh dear... she's gone missing again. Well, a royal banquet is boring for a child that age.
tm.「ただでさえ デルカダール王女の\n マルティナさまは おてんばで有名だし\n: "Princess Jade of Heliodor is already famed as a tomboy, so where could she have gone...
tm.「きゃー！ いけ！ そこよ！\n ああん もう じれったい！\n ほら とっとと: "Eek! Go! There! Ah, how frustrating! Come on, hurry up and beat it!!
tm.「あの兵士さん 魔物を倒せてよかった。\n どうやら 私のチカラづよい応援が\n: "I'm glad that soldier beat the monster. My strong cheering must have reached him.
tm.「アーウィンさまたちが\n 勇者さまを連れて １階に向かわれた……。: "Lord Irwin and the others took the Luminary to the first floor...
tm.「ユグノア王国の王子さま 初披露の宴だけあって\n お客さまは 由緒正しき王族ば: "As the banquet for Dundrasil's prince's debut, the guests are all of distinguished royal lineage. I must not be rude.
tm.「もう こんな所に\n 一秒だって いたくないわ。\n 早く 誰か助けにきて……: "I don't want to be here one more second. Someone, please come save us quickly...
tm.「あれっ？ 気のせいか……。\n 誰かに呼ばれたような気がしたんだが……。: "Huh? Must be my imagination... I thought someone called me.
tm.「まさか 魔物が来るとは……。\n ここは 持ちこたえられるだろうか……。: "I never expected monsters to come... Can we hold out here...
tm.「きゃー！ きゃー！\n 魔物よ 魔物よ！\n 兵士さん 早く助けて！: "Eek! Eek! Monsters! Monsters! Soldier, help quickly!
tm.「私のように か弱い女を狙うなんて\n 魔物って 最低なヤツらね！: "Targeting a helpless woman like me, monsters are the worst!
tm.「な なめるんじゃないわよ！\n 誰が アンタみたいなのに\n やられるもんです: "D-don't underestimate me! There's no way I'd lose to the likes of you!
tm.「……にしても アタシを口説いた あの男ったら\n ひとりで さっさと逃げちゃう: "...Still, that guy who hit on me ran off alone! If I make it out alive, I'll punch him...!
tm.「た 助かった……！ アタシを口説いた\n あの男 ひとりで逃げちゃうんですもの: "I-I'm saved...! That guy who hit on me ran off alone! That's why men can't be trusted!
tm.「まあ いやだ！\n ロウさまったら また新しいムフフ本を\n ベッドの下に 隠: "Oh, how awful! Lord Rab hid new naughty books under his bed again!
tm.「こないだ エレノアさまに\n 全部 見つかって 没収されたのに。\n まったく: "Lady Eleonor found them all and confiscated them the other day. Honestly... mutter, mutter.
tm.「ちょっと 大臣さま！\n 違う所に 隠れてくださいよ！\n 私も 見つかっちゃ: "Hey, Minister! Hide somewhere else! I'll get found too!
tm.「ロウさまが 熱心に読んでおられたのは\n ユグノアに古くより伝わる ローシュ戦: "Lord Rab was so engrossed in Erdwin's Chronicle, handed down in Dundrasil since ancient times. It says...
tm.「いやいや いかん いかん！\n {var:1}さまの誕生を祝う めでたき日に\: "No, no, I mustn't! On the happy day celebrating {var:1}'s birth, I won't think unnecessary things!
tm.「な な な なんたることだ！\n このユグノアが 魔物に襲われるとは！\n あ: "W-w-what a thing! Dundrasil attacked by monsters! Ah, Lord Irwin...!
tm.「うふふ そんなに あせらなくても\n 四大国会議が終われば すぐに\n {va: "Hee hee, no need to rush. Once the Four Great Nations Summit ends, {var:1} will be unveiled right away.
tm.「そういえば さっき アーウィンさまが\n デルカダールの王さまがいる中庭に向か: "Come to think of it, Lord Irwin just went to the courtyard where the King of Heliodor is. The summit may start soon.
tm.「しっかりして！ あなただけじゃないのよ！\n みんな 家に帰りたいのに\n こ: "Get a grip! It's not just you! Everyone wants to go home but is enduring this...!
tm.「{var:1}さまの お披露目は まだかしら？\n ユグノア王と 王妃の ご子: "Isn't {var:1}'s unveiling yet? As the son of Dundrasil's King and Queen, he must have a splendid face.
tm.「今は まだ赤ん坊だけれど\n いずれは このユグノアを背負う方。\n ああん！: "He's just a baby now, but someday he'll bear Dundrasil on his shoulders. Ah! I want to meet him soon.
tm.「さっきまで あんなに楽しかったのに\n どうして こんなことに……。\n 帰し: "It was so much fun until a moment ago. Why did this happen... Send me home, let me go home...
tm.「勇者さまが お生まれになった今\n ロトゼタシアの平和は 約束されたも同然。\: "With the Luminary born, Erdrea's peace is as good as promised. This too must be Yggdrasil's guidance.
